# Lamplight -- migration inventory and derivation

The AC-10.3 pattern, fourth and final application: every entry in Lamplight's `bin/.devbin/config.yaml` and every handler under `cmd/` is DERIVED from the launcher it replaces, via this document. Read the old side whole (`bin/lamplight`, `bin/lamplight_*`, `bin/lamplight_helpers.d/`, `bin/lamplight_macos.d/`, `bin/ll` -- 3,775 lines, 2026-08-09) before writing anything on the new side.

## The old surface

22 commands (`LAMPLIGHT_COMMANDS`): `server wrighter control iex repl cli test check canon fmt docs contract media models desktop publish db story build version macos content`. Shared options: `--fidelity off|echo|perf|high|walk` -> LLM_FIDELITY, `--env dev|test|desktop|prod` -> MIX_ENV (FOUR values -- desktop is real), `--repl` -> REPL_MODE=true, `--iex` -> LAMPLIGHT_IEX. Version: VERSION + FOUR sidecars (three Cargo.toml + the iOS Info.plist), derived-first-VERSION-last. Umbrella (apps/{lamplight,storyfield,frontdesk,control,wrighter,...}) + native/ Rust trees (cli gated, pdf_extractor deliberately outside CI's gate, ios dead, macos packaging) -- `LAMPLIGHT_GATED_CRATES="cli"` is the one home for the gate scope, every cargo call via `--manifest-path` (never cd). Seals: FOUR gates, lowercase family `<stamp>.{mix,rust,credo,lua}.*` + LATEST pointers + legacy `.test.` strays the mix runner's purge sweeps. `bin/ll` is a symlink to `lamplight` (rides the switch). Devbin's runlog IS this file's machinery -- all four extraction grammars byte-identical to the shipped ones (compared before install), the keepset/dangling-LATEST purge guard included.

## Command dispositions

| Old                             | New                             | Kind                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `server [target] [--iex]`       | `cmd/server`                    | Thin handler: storyfield/frontdesk/all targets with per-app cd (all = umbrella root, both endpoints :4002+:4003), LLM_FIDELITY default perf, D20 two command lines. Agent-banned by convention (no guard in the old file -- none added). hv's 2026-08-05 comma-list ruling: instances are an ARGUMENT and the parity work is Lamplight-side Elixir -- the port carries today's surface, the ruling carries forward. |
| `wrighter [--iex]`              | `cmd/wrighter`                  | Tier-1 auto: MIX_ENV=desktop, :4014, perf fidelity, D20's two lines (`iex -S mix` vs `mix run -e "...announce()" --no-halt` -- a second command line, not a prefix).                                       |
| `control`                       | `cmd/control`                   | Tier-1 auto: `mix do --app control control.boot` (Tidewave :4017).                                                                                                                                        |
| `iex`                           | `cmd/iex`                       | Thin: -h intercept + `exec iex -S mix` (no project env here, unlike the siblings -- the handler exists for the intercept alone).                                                                           |
| `repl`                          | `cmd/repl`                      | Thin: `mix lamplight.cli repl` under rlwrap; completions `bin/completions/repl.txt` (the file the builtin's assumption was MODELLED on -- it exists here), LAMPLIGHT_REPL_HISTORY.                          |
| `cli` / `-r` / `-l`             | `cmd/cli`                       | The native Rust CLI is the DEFAULT, args verbatim, deliberately NO -h intercept (clap owns --help) and NO cd (the CLI reads cwd for world detection); newer-debug-wins warning; `-l` = local arca one-shot with REPL_MODE. |
| `test mix/credo/lua/rust`       | `cmd/test.d/{mix,credo,lua,rust}` | Full ports of the four sealed runners onto lib/runlog (grammar_for x4). Suffixes -> MIX/CREDO/LUA/RUST. See "The promotions ruling" below.                                                              |
| `test walk/nlp`                 | `cmd/test.d/{walk,nlp}`         | The rlwrap REPL drivers: REPL_MODE default on, caller-CWD path absolutising, completions walk.txt/nlp.txt, per-driver histories.                                                                           |
| `test crank/play`               | `cmd/test.d/{crank,play}`       | Thin: `mix lamplight.crank` / `mix lamplight.playtest`.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `test doctor`                   | `cmd/test.d/doctor`             | The seal preflight, ported to drive DEVBIN's real purge fns (cmd/.lib/verify.sh): sections 1/2/3/5 verbatim; section 4 (legacy `.test.` strays) DROPPED WITH ITS REASON -- devbin's purge has no legacy param because the legacy family is extinct the moment the old runner dies; the switch-day hand-clean sweeps the existing strays. |
| bare `test` / unknown sub       | `cmd/test`                      | Topic rc 0; unknown -> die rc 1 listing the nine subs. NO `test all` exists and none appears: the cmd/test shadow keeps devbin's D8 synthesis out -- Lamplight never aggregated its gates and the mix leg takes half an hour. |
| `check corpus/coverage/integrity` | config rows                   | The domain verifications: `mix corpus.verify` / `mix control.run.coverage` / `mix control.ldn.integrity`, bare runs (no seal -- they exec'd in the old), `in_all: false` (the old excluded them from `all`: they answer "is the content sound", not "would CI accept this"). |
| `check compile`                 | catalogue row                   | `mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` at root, plain -- EXACT match, no entry.                                                                                                                        |
| `check format`                  | config override                 | TWO arms in one gate: `mix format --check-formatted` + `cargo fmt --check` per gated crate via --manifest-path. The catalogue derivation cannot express the crate scoping (root cargo fmt has no Cargo.toml to find). `run: cmd/.lib/check-format`, grammar generic, log FORMAT. |
| `check deps`                    | config `in_all: false`          | Catalogue row matches the command; the old EXCLUDES it from `all` by authored ruling (permanently red via arca_cli's transitive logger deps -- "a gate that always reds trains its reader to ignore it"). in_all: false keeps it invocable, out of all, announced as skipped. |
| `check toolchain`               | config override                 | THREE tools (elixir/erlang/RUST -- rust is pinned here and clippy's lint set moves with it), PLUS a NEW Dockerfile arm the old gate lacked: the image sat at 1.20.1/29.0.2 while the pins moved twice, and no gate said so. The blindness is the argument. `run: cmd/.lib/check-toolchain`, grammar generic, log TOOLCHAIN. AC-11.11 data: 3 of 3 image-bearing projects now check their image. |
| `check clippy`                  | config override                 | CI parity: `native/cli` only, NO --all-targets (the catalogue row is root + --all-targets). `run: cmd/.lib/check-clippy`, grammar cargo, log CLIPPY.                                                       |
| `check critic`                  | catalogue @builtin              | Same logic byte-for-byte; author/content (prose packs, no headless critic) drop out of the intersection naturally, both sides.                                                                             |
| `check parity`                  | config row                      | The capability fence AS a scoped mix test (never a proxy count -- the standing rule). `run: mix test apps/lamplight/test/lamplight/contract/capability_coverage_test.exs`, grammar mix, log PARITY.        |
| `check all`                     | synthesised                     | Old order: toolchain format compile clippy critic parity. New: declared rows first (toolchain format clippy parity), catalogue after (compile, critic); the in_all:false rows announce as skipped. Coverage: the SAME six gates. Order + skip-announcements recorded as deliberate differences. |
| `canon lint`                    | `cmd/canon`                     | Thin: `mix lamplight.canon.lint`.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `fmt [paths] [--check]`         | config `fmt.options.ldn`        | Lamplight's fmt formats LDN CONTENT (`mix control.ldn.fmt`), not Elixir. Declared as the `ldn` arm (run: bare, args pass through -- `--check` and `--comment-col-width` are the TASK's own flags and ride to it); the elixir/rust/md catalogue arms are ALL disabled (`enabled: false`): old fmt never ran mix format or cargo fmt (those live in check format / build cli) and never touched markdown (the hook owns that). `fmt all` = ldn alone, exactly the old bare fmt. |
| `docs`                          | `cmd/docs`                      | Thin: `mix lamplight.docs.generate` -- nothing like the builtin's agents/treeindex surface, and the old had neither. The shadow keeps the project's own meaning of the word.                                |
| `contract generate/check`       | `cmd/contract`                  | generate -> mix task; check -> the fence set expanded at run time, through the mix runner in gate mode (`--no-out --with-errors`), empty expansion dies.                                                    |
| `media prompts/images`          | `cmd/media`                     | Mix tasks with option parsing.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `media shrink/covers`           | `cmd/media.d/{shrink,covers}`   | The standalone bash tools as D3 sub-handlers (args raw, exactly as the old dispatch). Both SOURCE the old helpers -- their source stanzas retarget to `$DEVBIN_LIB/helpers` + `../.lib/lamplight`.          |
| `models [sub]`                  | `cmd/models`                    | Thin: `mix lamplight.models` (bare = list).                                                                                                                                                               |
| `desktop build/dev/clean`       | `cmd/desktop`                   | build: the Tauri pipeline verbatim (desktop-BEAM pgrep guard, consolidated-protocols dance, orphaned-lib-dir rm, resources copy); dev DELEGATES to `devbin wrighter` (one launch path); clean.              |
| `publish <dir>`                 | opt-in + `cmd/publish`          | `mix lamplight.publish` (LDN worlds -> Content DB). Catalogue ships the name (D22).                                                                                                                       |
| `db proxy/seed`                 | `cmd/db`                        | proxy: fly PGBouncer-IPv6 resolve + proxy; seed: worlds/_build guard + module-cache clear + `mix lamplight.cli ll.seed`. NO setup/migrate/codegen here (unlike every sibling) -- the shadow also keeps the catalogue's ecto rows from surfacing verbs the project never had. |
| `story <uuid> [--prod]`         | `cmd/story`                     | The extractor with the --prod fly-proxy flow (config/.env sourcing, DATABASE_URL guard, the --no-start socket-options override) verbatim.                                                                  |
| `build cli/deploy/grammar`      | `cmd/build`                     | cli: the native pipeline (fmt-check, clippy, cargo test via test.d/rust in gate mode, release build, stage); deploy: the FULL release pipeline with runner references retargeted to test.d siblings + `devbin desktop` + `devbin macos`; grammar: regenerate/--check/--install. Deploy is human-run; dispatch-verified only. |
| `version ...`                   | catalogue @builtin + config     | `version_from` VERSION (default) + FOUR `version_sidecars` (tauri/cli/pdf_extractor Cargo.toml + iOS Info.plist) -- the EXACT case the sidecar recipes were built for; devbin writes derived-first-VERSION-last, same as the old sync_version. `version sync`/`check` become REAL here (the first project where they have work). |
| `macos <sub>`                   | opt-in + `cmd/macos` + `cmd/macos.d/` | The handler ports; the `.d` tree moves VERBATIM beside it as private resources (issue 0005's exact home: `macos.d/pkg` is a directory beside real scripts, and is_handler already refuses to exec it). The three scripts that source the old helpers (build-pkg/notarize/verify) get retargeted source stanzas; selftest.sh stays deliberately standalone; the `.sh` suffixes keep every script out of D3 descent, so dispatch stays through cmd/macos exactly as old. |
| `content link`                  | opt-in + `cmd/content`          | The world-repo symlinker; unknown sub -> warn + rc 2 (the old's own quirk, kept).                                                                                                                          |
| bare `lamplight` / `-v`         | dispatcher                      | Bare -> full help rc 0; `-v` -> `lamplight <version>` ✓.                                                                                                                                                  |
| unknown command                 | dispatcher                      | rc 2 both.                                                                                                                                                                                                |

## The promotions ruling (surfaced for hv, not slipped through)

Lamplight's four runners disagree about zero-work runs, ON PURPOSE: credo and lua carry TWO promotions each with NO escape flag ("an empty scope is always a mistake" / "a gate read for an estate-wide verdict fails on a run that examined nothing"), while the MIX runner deliberately tolerates a zero-test rc 0 -- its siblings' own headers state the reasoning: "a filter matching nothing is a legitimate request there". That is an AUTHORED position, not Laksa's oversight. The port OVERRIDES it to the fleet shape -- both zero shapes promote, `--allow-empty` is the per-invocation escape -- because the escape flag expresses exactly the legitimate-request case the old ruling protected, per-invocation instead of always-on, and because `build deploy`'s own lua leg already names the degraded-scope hazard the tolerance invites. credo and lua keep their no-escape promotions verbatim (strictER stays); rust keeps its advisory "no tests ran" print with the same promotion added. Recorded here, in the pack, and in the test topic; hv can reverse it with one flag default if the old tolerance is wanted back.

## Options

`fidelity` (values off/echo/perf/high/walk -> LLM_FIDELITY), `env` (dev/test/desktop/prod -> MIX_ENV), `repl` (flag -> REPL_MODE) declared; `--iex` is D20 framework-owned (LAMPLIGHT_IEX reads become DEVBIN_OPT_IEX). The anywhere-in-argv difference has ONE new exposure here: the old `cli` rust path parsed NOTHING (args verbatim to clap), and the dispatcher now consumes declared options anywhere -- probed at equivalence against the Rust CLI's actual flag surface; documented in the cli topic.

## The switch-day map

- `bin/lamplight` -> symlink; `bin/ll` is already a symlink to `lamplight` and rides unchanged.
- The 31 `lamplight_*` files + `lamplight_helpers.d/` delete; `lamplight_macos.d/` -> `cmd/macos.d/` (git mv, three source-stanza edits).
- `bin/completions/{repl,walk,nlp}.txt` stay at their old paths.
- Old lowercase seals + `.test.` legacy strays hand-cleaned via case-sensitive `find -name` ('*.mix.*' '*.rust.*' '*.credo.*' '*.lua.*' '*.test.out' lowercase forms), LATEST_* re-pointed by the first new runs.

## Toolchain sweep (hv's standing directive)

- `.tool-versions`: erlang 29.0.5, elixir 1.20.3-otp-29, rust 1.97.1 -- already current; untouched.
- Dockerfile ARGs: 1.20.1 / 29.0.2 / bookworm-20260610-slim -> 1.20.3 / 29.0.5 / registry-verified current tag. THE IMAGE LAGGED THE PINS TWICE WITH NO GATE SAYING SO -- the new toolchain arm exists because of exactly this file.
- CI fallbacks: elixir 1.20.2 -> 1.20.3, erlang 29.0.4 -> 29.0.5 (rust 1.97.1 already matches its pin).

## Help

22 authored topics; rulings extracted first (the LATEST/seal doctrine, the credo file-not-directory scoping, lua's two halves + --only semantics, the deploy pipeline's non-skippable seals, the release/debug CLI trap, the umbrella `mix do --app` notes, the never-quote-parity rule, the deps permanent-red story). The pre-commit hook RUNS `prettier --write` over staged .md (the Laksa hazard, live here): every topic is authored in the stable form (one line per paragraph, 4-space literal blocks, backticked globs) and proven `prettier --check` clean under the project's own config before its first commit.

## Old-side gates, verbatim, for the equivalence pack

`test mix` (SUITE-SCOPED -- the full suite is the half-hour leg; a small app dir both sides), `test credo` (whole umbrella), `test lua --only framework` (the in-repo half -- the content half needs `content link` symlinks), `test rust` (native/cli), `test doctor` (the preflight, old machinery vs the ported fence on devbin's), `check {compile,format,toolchain,clippy,critic,parity}` and the all composition, `check deps` (red on BOTH sides -- the arca_cli transitive story -- carried as a matching red, not fixed), `which`? (no which here), `version`/`-v`/`version show` byte-probes, `version check` (four sidecars -- REAL work now), stubs: none (Lamplight has no stubs). Old-side reds expected today: `check deps` (authored permanent red), and the NEW toolchain arm red until the Dockerfile bump (the old arm blind -- recorded as the strengthening pair, not a matching red).
